source.title: Life Insurance Underwriting Guide
source.note: Extracted from the guide for agent reference. Not an underwriting decision tool.

age.label: Age
age.why: Age and coverage amount together set which medical requirements apply.

face_amount.label: Coverage amount
face_amount.ask: How much coverage are they looking at?
face_amount.why: With age, this decides whether an exam, labs or physician records are needed.

tobacco.label: Tobacco or nicotine
tobacco.ask: Any tobacco or nicotine use, and how long ago?

options.label: Never, or more than 5 years ago

tobacco.why: The non-tobacco classes use 12, 36 and 60 month cut-offs. Includes vaping, pouches, patches and gum.

build.label: Height and weight
build.ask: What are the client's height and weight?
build.why: Underwriting uses a height and weight table as one of its guidelines.

physical_24m.label: Physical in the last 24 months
physical_24m.ask: Has the client had routine health care and a physical exam in the last 24 months?
physical_24m.why: For ages 60 and over, the application is declined without one.

need.label: Need
need.why: Underwriting confirms the amount is reasonable for the purpose of the coverage.

earned_income.label: Annual earned income
earned_income.ask: What is the client's annual earned income?
earned_income.why: Income replacement is limited to a multiple of earned income that depends on age.

budget.label: Budget
budget.ask: What annual premium are they comfortable with?
budget.why: Households with modest income generally should not put more than 10% of income into premiums.

existing_coverage.label: Existing coverage
existing_coverage.ask: Does the client have any life insurance in force, and will any of it be replaced?
existing_coverage.why: A required application question that is commonly missed, and existing NLG coverage changes the requirements.

state.label: State
state.ask: Which state will the application be signed in?
state.why: New York has a $2M limit on some classes and needs the Confidential Financial Questionnaire on every application.

medication.label: Medication
medication.ask: What prescription medications does the client take, now or in the past?
medication.why: The prescription database goes back seven years; the application asks for the name and purpose of each.

when.label: When diagnosed
when.ask: When was {condition} diagnosed, and when was the last episode, surgery or change?
when.why: The guide's criteria for most conditions depend on time since diagnosis or recovery.

severity.label: Type or severity
severity.ask: What type or how severe is the {condition}?
severity.why: The guide's best-case assumptions are usually for the mild or early-stage form.

treatment.label: Treatment
treatment.why: Current treatment, surgery or certain medications change how the guide treats the condition.

stable.label: Stable or controlled

options.label: Not fully controlled, or recent changes

stable.ask: Is the {condition} stable and well controlled?
stable.why: The guide's best-case assumptions are for a condition that is optimally controlled.

complications.label: Complications
complications.ask: Any complications, lasting effects or related conditions from the {condition}?
complications.why: The guide's best-case assumptions are without complications or residual effects.

insulin.label: Uses insulin
insulin.ask: Is the diabetes treated with insulin?
insulin.why: Diabetes treated by insulin, or combined with tobacco use, may need physician records at any coverage amount.

anemia_iron_deficient.label: Anemia, Iron-deficient
anemia_iron_deficient.guide_text: mild, single episode, resolved, no splenectomy

anemia_sickle_cell.label: Anemia, Sickle-cell
anemia_sickle_cell.guide_text: mild, adults only, last episode > 5 years ago, no organ damage

aneurysm.label: Aneurysm
aneurysm.guide_text: surgically corrected >6 months ago, resolved with no ongoing symptoms

anxiety.label: Anxiety
anxiety.guide_text: depends on age, mild & stable, not chronic, diagnosis ≥ 6 months ago

aortic_insufficiency.label: Aortic insufficiency
aortic_insufficiency.guide_text: mild, age ≥ 50, no underlying disease, aortic valve only & no surgery

atrial_fibrillation.label: Atrial fibrillation
atrial_fibrillation.guide_text: mild, not chronic, no underlying disease, depends on frequency & cause

asthma.label: Asthma
asthma.guide_text: mild, depends on age, treatment, number & frequency of attacks, no limitations

autism.label: Autism
autism.guide_text: mild, age >8 years, no other mental health disorders or epilepsy

back_disorder_pain.label: Back disorder/pain
back_disorder_pain.guide_text: mild, non-disabling, depends on dosage/number of opioid medications

basal_cell_carcinoma.label: Basal cell carcinoma
basal_cell_carcinoma.guide_text: in-situ or ≤2 cm, no invasion or lymph node involvement

bronchiectasis.label: Bronchiectasis
bronchiectasis.guide_text: mild to moderate without daily symptoms, no surgery or hospitalization

bronchitis_chronic.label: Bronchitis, chronic
bronchitis_chronic.guide_text: mild, minimal dyspnea, no home oxygen treatment or hospitalization

bundle_branch_block.label: Bundle Branch Block
bundle_branch_block.guide_text: mild, stable, normal cardiac evaluation. No complete Left BBB

cancer.label: Cancer
cancer.guide_text: depends on pathology, in remission & not currently under treatment

cardiomyopathy.label: Cardiomyopathy
cardiomyopathy.guide_text: depends on type and age, diagnosis >2 years ago, stable/resolved

cerebral_palsy.label: Cerebral palsy
cerebral_palsy.guide_text: age >6 years, no epilepsy or intellectual disability

copd.label: COPD
copd.guide_text: mild, minimal dyspnea, no home oxygen treatment or hospitalization

congestive_heart_failure.label: Congestive Heart Failure
congestive_heart_failure.guide_text: mild, diastolic dysfunction only, resolved without symptoms

coronary_artery_disease.label: Coronary Artery Disease
coronary_artery_disease.guide_text: mild, depends on treatment, age & artery(ies) involved

crohn_s_disease.label: Crohn’s disease
crohn_s_disease.guide_text: mild, age >30, more than 5 years since diagnosis or last major attack

cystitis.label: Cystitis
cystitis.guide_text: single episode, fully recovered, no ongoing symptoms or treatment

deep_vein_thrombosis.label: Deep Vein Thrombosis
deep_vein_thrombosis.guide_text: single episode, no underlying disease, recovered >2 months ago

depression.label: Depression
depression.guide_text: mild, stable & well-controlled for >6 months, no relapses

diabetes_type_1.label: Diabetes, Type 1
diabetes_type_1.guide_text: depends on age & disease duration, stable, no complications

diabetes_type_2.label: Diabetes, Type 2
diabetes_type_2.guide_text: depends on age & disease duration, stable, no complications

diverticulitis.label: Diverticulitis
diverticulitis.guide_text: mild, no planned surgery, no current treatment, resolved

drug_abuse.label: Drug abuse
drug_abuse.guide_text: depends on substance(s), total abstinence for >6 years, no relapses

emphysema.label: Emphysema
emphysema.guide_text: mild, minimal dyspnea, no home oxygen treatment or hospitalization

endocarditis.label: Endocarditis
endocarditis.guide_text: diagnosis >1 year ago, normal heart valves and no heart damage

epilepsy.label: Epilepsy
epilepsy.guide_text: diagnosis >6 months ago, average ≤12 seizures per year, last seizure >1 year ago

esophageal_stricture.label: Esophageal stricture
esophageal_stricture.guide_text: mild, confirmed benign, no ongoing symptoms

fibromyalgia.label: Fibromyalgia
fibromyalgia.guide_text: mild, no physical or psychiatric impairments, no narcotic medication use

gallbladder_disorder.label: Gallbladder disorder
gallbladder_disorder.guide_text: mild, recovery >3 months ago, no pending investigation or surgery

gastric_bypass.label: Gastric bypass
gastric_bypass.guide_text: depends on procedure, >6 months since surgery, no re-hospitalizations

gout.label: Gout
gout.guide_text: mild, only NSAID use, no ongoing therapy, no physical impairments

head_injury.label: Head injury
head_injury.guide_text: single event, mild and >3 months since injury, fully recovered, no limitations

heart_valve_surgery.label: Heart valve surgery
heart_valve_surgery.guide_text: single valve, depends on age, fully recovered, >1 year since surgery

hepatitis_b_chronic.label: Hepatitis B, chronic
hepatitis_b_chronic.guide_text: fully resolved with normal liver enzymes and no liver damage

hepatitis_c_chronic.label: Hepatitis C, chronic
hepatitis_c_chronic.guide_text: fully resolved with normal liver enzymes and no liver damage

hypertension.label: Hypertension
hypertension.guide_text: see guidelines on pages 28-31, no other ratable health conditions

hiv.label: HIV
hiv.guide_text: age >18, CD4 counts stable for 2 years, undetectable viral load, no hepatitis or AIDS

hodgkin_s_disease.label: Hodgkin’s disease
hodgkin_s_disease.guide_text: stage 1A or better, remission for >3 years, no recurrence

hyperthyroid.label: Hyperthyroid
hyperthyroid.guide_text: stable ≥ 1 year, not current anti-thyroid medication, no atrial fibrillation

hypothyroid.label: Hypothyroid
hypothyroid.guide_text: stable with no ratable hypertension or cardiovascular abnormalities

intellectual_disability.label: Intellectual disability
intellectual_disability.guide_text: mild, age >8, no physical or psychiatric impairments or limitations

joint_replacement.label: Joint replacement
joint_replacement.guide_text: fully recovered, surgery >3 months ago, no chronic pain or disease

kidney_disease_chronic.label: Kidney disease, chronic
kidney_disease_chronic.guide_text: mild, controlled blood pressure, normal kidney function

leukemia.label: Leukemia
leukemia.guide_text: varies based on age, type & severity, remission >5 years with no recurrence

lupus_systemic.label: Lupus, systemic
lupus_systemic.guide_text: mild, fully resolved >6 months ago, no current symptoms or treatment

lupus_discoid.label: Lupus, discoid
lupus_discoid.guide_text: mild, skin only, no current treatment with corticosteroid medications

melanoma.label: Melanoma
melanoma.guide_text: single occurrence, stage ≤1A, completely excised and resolved >2 years ago

meningitis.label: Meningitis
meningitis.guide_text: non-tuberculous variant only, fully recovered >6 months, no current symptoms

migraine_headaches.label: Migraine headaches
migraine_headaches.guide_text: mild, stable with no underlying disease or adverse features

mitral_valve_prolapse.label: Mitral valve prolapse
mitral_valve_prolapse.guide_text: mild, no symptoms, no disease, regurgitation or stenosis, no surgery

mitral_regurgitation.label: Mitral regurgitation
mitral_regurgitation.guide_text: mild, stable, depends on age, no underlying disease, no surgery

multiple_sclerosis.label: Multiple Sclerosis
multiple_sclerosis.guide_text: mild, stable, >1 year since diagnosis, non-disabling or progressive

muscular_dystrophy.label: Muscular dystrophy
muscular_dystrophy.guide_text: depends on type, mild with slow progression and minimal disability

myositis.label: Myositis
myositis.guide_text: malignancy excluded, treatment completed >3 years ago, fully recovered

myocarditis.label: Myocarditis
myocarditis.guide_text: single episode, no underlying disease, resolution >3 months ago

nephritis_acute.label: Nephritis, Acute
nephritis_acute.guide_text: fully recovered >1 year ago, no ongoing treatment or underlying disease

non_hodgkin_s_lymphoma.label: Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma
non_hodgkin_s_lymphoma.guide_text: stage 1 or better, remission for >3 years, no recurrence

osteoarthritis.label: Osteoarthritis
osteoarthritis.guide_text: mild, non-disabling, no continuous opioid use for treatment

osteomyelitis.label: Osteomyelitis
osteomyelitis.guide_text: mild, <2 attacks total, last attack >1 year ago, no history of amputation

pacemaker.label: Pacemaker
pacemaker.guide_text: depends on underlying condition, normal pulse, >3 months since implanted

pancreatitis_acute.label: Pancreatitis, Acute
pancreatitis_acute.guide_text: no alcohol concerns, fully recovered, last episode >3 years ago

paralysis.label: Paralysis
paralysis.guide_text: no paraparesis, > 3 years since injury, fully adjusted, not wheelchair dependent

parkinson_s_disease.label: Parkinson’s disease
parkinson_s_disease.guide_text: mild, age >59, tremor only in fingers, no treatment, no dementia

pericarditis.label: Pericarditis
pericarditis.guide_text: viral, single episode, recovered >3 months ago, normal EKG, no effusion

peripheral_vascular_disease.label: Peripheral vascular disease
peripheral_vascular_disease.guide_text: mild, no evidence of diabetes or cardiovascular disease

phlebitis.label: Phlebitis
phlebitis.guide_text: fully recovered, no ongoing treatment, pulmonary embolism or underlying disease

polycystic_kidney_disease.label: Polycystic kidney disease
polycystic_kidney_disease.guide_text: diagnosis age >20, normal renal function, no kidney damage

polycythemia_vera.label: Polycythemia vera
polycythemia_vera.guide_text: no thrombosis, no myelosuppressive drug use, diagnosis >2 years ago

pregnancy_current.label: Pregnancy, current
pregnancy_current.guide_text: age <40, in good health, no past or current pregnancy complications

prostatic_hypertrophy_benign.label: Prostatic hypertrophy, Benign
prostatic_hypertrophy_benign.guide_text: stable minor symptoms only, no obstruction or neoplasia

prostatitis.label: Prostatitis
prostatitis.guide_text: mild infrequent symptoms, no obstruction or neoplasia, normal urinalysis

raynaud_s_syndrome.label: Raynaud’s syndrome
raynaud_s_syndrome.guide_text: no disability, no underlying disease, last complication >2 years ago

rheumatoid_arthritis.label: Rheumatoid arthritis
rheumatoid_arthritis.guide_text: mild, depends on age & duration, no disability, only NSAID use

rheumatic_fever.label: Rheumatic fever
rheumatic_fever.guide_text: single episode, no residual heart murmur, no heart damage

sarcoidosis.label: Sarcoidosis
sarcoidosis.guide_text: depends on organs involved, mild/stage 1, >6 months since diagnosis

seizures.label: Seizures
seizures.guide_text: mild, stable, average of ≤12 seizures per year, last seizure >1 year ago

sleep_apnea.label: Sleep Apnea
sleep_apnea.guide_text: mild, not central or mixed apnea, consistent CPAP use, no adverse factors

stroke_cva.label: Stroke (CVA)
stroke_cva.guide_text: varies based on type, fully recovered, single episode >6 months ago

suicide_attempt.label: Suicide attempt
suicide_attempt.guide_text: single attempt >5 years ago, stable with no ongoing symptoms

thalassemia.label: Thalassemia
thalassemia.guide_text: trait only, stable hemoglobin ≤10.0 for 5 years, no anemia treatment

transient_ischemic_attack_tia.label: Transient ischemic attack (TIA)
transient_ischemic_attack_tia.guide_text: single episode, no underlying disease, fully recovered

tuberculosis.label: Tuberculosis
tuberculosis.guide_text: treatment completed >3 months ago, normal lung function, negative HIV

tumors_benign.label: Tumors, Benign
tumors_benign.guide_text: varies by organ, no obstruction, underlying disease, or pending surgery

ulcerative_colitis.label: Ulcerative Colitis
ulcerative_colitis.guide_text: mild, diagnosis >6 months ago, no immunosuppressive medications

varicose_veins.label: Varicose veins
varicose_veins.guide_text: located on leg, no underlying disease or thrombosis

conditions_note.text: Potential rate classes shown assume the condition has been fully evaluated and is optimally controlled without complications or residual effects. Multiple conditions may alter the potential offer, and final rating will depend on the specific details of the individual case. The "Potential Best Offer" guidelines are provided as a courtesy for information purposes and should not be interpreted as tentative quotes or binding in any way.

knockouts.intro: Applications should not be written on individuals presenting the following impairments or issues. This list is not intended to be all inclusive.
medical: Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm (present or surgery <6 months ago)
Alcohol Treatment within the past 2 years
ALS (Lou Gehrig's Disease)
Alzheimer's Disease
Cancer currently under treatment (any type)
Cirrhosis of the Liver
Cystic Fibrosis
Dementia
Down Syndrome
Epilepsy/seizures diagnosed within the past 6 months
Gastric bypass surgery within the past 6 months
Heart attack and/or heart surgery within the past 6 months
Heart disorder requiring a defibrillator
Heart valve surgery within the past 12 months
Illegal drug use within the past 3 years
Kidney failure requiring dialysis
Lung disease, severe or requiring oxygen
Mental health disorder requiring hospitalization within the past 12 months
Organ transplant, awaiting or recipient
Pregnancy with current or past complications
Suicide attempt within the past year; or more than one attempt within the past 2 years
Surgery, pending
non_medical: Bankruptcy, Chapter 7, that has not been discharged
Driver's License currently suspended or revoked
Single DUI within the past year
Multiple DUIs within the past 5 years
Probation or parole, current or <12 months since ending
Multiple criminal convictions, <7 years since last conviction
IOLI/SOLI - Investor or Stranger Owned Life Insurance

codes.M: Application, exam, blood profile, urine, mature assessment
codes.ME: Application, exam, blood profile, urine, EKG, mature assessment

notes: Issue age is age nearest birthday.
Existing coverage with National Life Group will impact the needed requirements.
Medical testing may be requested for cause (such as diabetes or morbid obesity).

conditions_any_amount: Diabetes treated by insulin/with tobacco use
Mental Disorders requiring multiple or psychotropic medications
Emergency room visit or hospitalization in the last 6 months

ez_underwriting.text: Accelerated underwriting: the client may be eligible for the best class without blood profile, urinalysis, paramedical exam or EKG.

expanded_limits.requires: A routine physical exam with age-appropriate screening tests within the last 12 months.

income_multiples.note: Earned income only: money received from paid work, not investments, rental property, alimony or savings.

tobacco.note: Tobacco rates may be applicable for marijuana use depending on delivery method and frequency of use.

Elite.health: No personal health history of coronary artery disease, hepatitis B or C, diabetes, melanoma, or cancer (except skin cancer in situ).
Elite.blood_pressure: 12-month average of 135/85 or better; treatment with one drug is acceptable.
Elite.cholesterol: Cholesterol/HDL ratio 4.5 or less (5.0 at ages 65+); total 260 mg/dl or less; one drug is acceptable.
Elite.family_history: No parental death from coronary artery disease or cancer before age 65.
Elite.alcohol_drugs: No history of drug or alcohol abuse or treatment at any time.
Elite.driving: No reckless or alcohol-related violations in 5 years, no suspension in 3 years, no more than one moving violation in 3 years.

Preferred.health: No personal health history of coronary artery disease, hepatitis B or C, diabetes, melanoma, or cancer (except skin cancer in situ).
Preferred.blood_pressure: 12-month average of 140/90 or better; treatment with one drug is acceptable.
Preferred.cholesterol: Cholesterol/HDL ratio 5.5 or less (6.0 at ages 65+); total 280 mg/dl or less; one drug is acceptable.
Preferred.family_history: No parental death from coronary artery disease or cancer before age 60.
Preferred.alcohol_drugs: No history of drug or alcohol abuse or treatment within the last 10 years.
Preferred.driving: No reckless or alcohol-related violations in 5 years, no suspension in 3 years, no more than two moving violations in 3 years.

Select.health: No current borderline medical problems. No currently ratable medical history.
Select.cholesterol: Cholesterol/HDL ratio 6.5 or less (7.0 at ages 65+); total 300 mg/dl or less; one drug is acceptable.
Select.family_history: No more than one parental death from coronary artery disease or cancer before age 60.
Select.alcohol_drugs: No ratable history of drug or alcohol abuse.
Select.driving: No reckless or alcohol-related violations in 5 years, no suspension in 3 years, no more than three moving violations in 3 years.

build_table.note: A guideline to the weights usually acceptable within the rate classes shown. Other factors, including age or disproportion in body measurements, may impact the final decision. Individual consideration will be given for low BMIs.

rules.text: Applicants age 60 and over must have routine health care and a physical exam within the past 24 months; otherwise, the application will be declined.
For juvenile coverage the child must be at least 14 days old and a U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Ownership is limited to parents, legal guardians or grandparents.
Income replacement is not applicable at ages 70 and over.
Households with modest annual income generally should not exceed 10% of income for life insurance premiums.
An application is good for 6 months from the signing date. A Statement of Health is required after 90 days from the date of last evidence.
Paramedical exams and labs are good for 12 months up to age 70, and 6 months at ages 70 and up.
Motor Vehicle Reports are ordered on all applicants ages 16 and up, at all face amounts.
Medical testing should not be ordered until the applicant has completed an application and signed the authorization, HIPAA and HIV consent forms.
If state or federal aid, SSI or SSDI is the applicant's only source of income, coverage is not offered.
A non-working spouse can match the working spouse's in-force or pending coverage up to $1,000,000; more requires financial justification.
Whether any in-force life insurance will be replaced is a required application question that is commonly missed. Replacement and 1035 forms are submitted through the Agent Portal.
For a tentative, non-binding assessment of a specific client's medical history, use the XRAE underwriting quote tool.
